ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominant low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (light) pixels restricted to small mottled regions; macro-contrast is high against the bright, frothy water background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-toned surface; visible high-intensity (light grey) mottling localized immediately around the median notch and a few faint, light-toned streaks on the interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is distinct and clearly divides the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; multiple jagged peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes, most pronounced on the mid-section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both flukes; some lighter, circular mottling clusters near the lower-central region of the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark vertical linear mark (rake-like) on the mid-right lobe; several faint horizontal pixel disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serrations and notches on the trailing edges; distinct vertical scar/mark on the surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Solid dark pigmentation at the extreme distal tips (corners) of the fluke lobes.
